findings.comment: The drawing identifies the part as sheet metal with welding notes but fails to specify the material thickness in the title block, notes, or dimensions. Without a defined thickness, the part cannot be manufactured or inspected correctly.
findings.recommended_correction: Add the sheet metal thickness to the title block material field or as a specific note/dimension.

findings.requirement: Weld preparation (bevel angle, root gap) is dimensioned for full-penetration welds

evidence.quote: SHEETMETAL WELDING NOTE :-(English) 1) ALL JOINTS TO BE SUITABLE WELD & FINISHED

findings.comment: The welding note requires joints to be welded but does not dimension the weld preparation (bevel angle, root gap) for full-penetration welds. This omission prevents the welder from preparing the joint correctly to achieve the required penetration.
findings.recommended_correction: Add dimensions for weld preparation (bevel angle and root gap) to the relevant views or detail sections.
